name: Riposto (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Riposto (quartered with a sun, a ship, a tower and grapes) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Riposto, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were granted by royal decree on 19 January 1882.

features.role: Riposto arms — quartered with a sun, a ship, a tower and grapes, crowned, within branches
